name: Real Cartoon
source:
One of the palettes. He feels no qualms about taking lives, and he treats carnage as a mere task. After subjugating Colors, he rose to the position of Palette.

By becoming Colors, he loses everything and is in a position to be chased, but with the help of the princess, he sets out on a journey to restore her colors.
